title: 第12章 田荣之乱
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

如果刘邦称帝后发表获奖感言，他要感谢的人很多，但有一个人千万不能落下——田荣。他不是刘邦的合作伙伴，却胜似最佳拍档，配合得妙到毫巅。他不是项羽的仇人，却比仇人伤项羽更深，可以说，没有他捣乱就没有刘邦的大汉天下，因为就在刘邦出川还定三秦、项羽准备出兵之时，怎么就那么巧呢？齐地的田荣先造反了。“项羽小儿，有本事来打我啊！”

如果刘邦表达不满的方式是主动逃，那么田荣表达不满的方式则是主动干。田荣之所以敢主动干是有原因的，田荣是齐国田氏宗族出身，秦国灭齐后，田荣与堂兄田儋、弟弟田横隐居于狄县。我们都知道最早在齐国复辟的是田儋，然而田儋很快就被章邯干掉了，于是田荣接过了起义的接力棒。

此时，齐国后院起火，故齐王田建的弟弟田假被齐人公推为齐王。面对这样突如其来的变故，田荣不干了，马上进行了窝里斗，结果成功把田假赶出了齐地。田假势单力孤，马上找到了楚怀王这把庇护伞。楚怀王本着人道主义精神收留了他。田荣拿田假没办法了，于是便拥立田儋的儿子田市为王，继续起义。

这时项梁大败章邯，追击到了定陶。章邯选择了死守，项梁则一心想早点清理掉章邯这个起义军的障碍，于是，他一边围城，一边向附近的齐国求救。

齐国自然是田荣说了算，田荣对项梁说：“要我出兵那是小菜一碟，但有个条件，就是得交出田假来。”

出卖盟友的事正直的项梁是不会干的，结果田荣以此为由拒不发兵，最终导致项梁被章邯偷袭成功喋血沙场。

如果不是你田荣唯利是图、见死不救，我叔父又怎么会死呢？家仇不共戴天！项羽对田荣恨之入骨。

巨鹿之战时，各路诸侯都派兵来救赵国，尽管他们都是虚张声势、见风使舵，好歹出来撑场面了，唯独田荣不发一兵一卒，连作秀的过场都直接免了。

在章邯等秦将投降后，各路诸侯都追随项羽入关，唯独田荣还是头脑不开窍，没有任何表示。

正是因为家仇国恨交织着，项羽非常憎恨田荣，“戏亭分封”时，田都、田安、田市这些小字辈都得到了分封，唯独没有田荣的份。

当时田荣还是心存幻想的，选择在家静候佳音。很快，他就收到了一封田都亲笔写来的“拆迁令”，命他即日起搬出临淄，临淄从此归田都使用，谢绝讨价还价，令到即行，不得有误！

田荣看完后暴跳如雷，你田都算什么东西，现在居然敢骑到我头上来作威作福了，真是无法无天！田荣马上带兵去攻打田都，田都哪里是田荣的对手？很快，他就以败军之将的身份逃到了楚国，投奔“大哥”项羽去了。

田荣保住了临淄，心里很满意，还把田市召回了齐国。他对田市说：“你不要怕，有叔叔在，没有人能把你的地盘抢走。”

但是对田市来说，田荣的话并没有起到定心丸的作用，反而起了催化剂的作用。在田市眼里，尽管田荣很残暴，但项羽更残暴；尽管田荣很恐怖，但项羽更恐怖。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

If Liu Bang delivers an acceptance speech after becoming emperor, he will have many people to thank, but one person must not be left behind - Tian Rong.He is not Liu Bang's partner, but he is better than the best partner, and his cooperation is perfect.He was not Xiang Yu's enemy, but he hurt Xiang Yu more deeply than his enemies. It can be said that without him causing trouble, there would be no Liu Bang's Han Dynasty, because just when Liu Bang came out of Sichuan, the Three Qin Dynasty was decided, and Xiang Yu was preparing to send troops, how could it be such a coincidence?Tian Rong of Qidi rebelled first."Xiang Yu, kid, come and beat me if you can!"

If Liu Bang expressed his dissatisfaction by taking the initiative to escape, then Tian Rong's way of expressing his dissatisfaction was by taking the initiative to commit suicide.There is a reason why Tian Rong dared to take the initiative. Tian Rong was born in the Tian clan of Qi State. After the Qin State destroyed Qi, Tian Rong lived in seclusion in Di County with his cousin Tian Dan and younger brother Tian Heng.We all know that Tian Dan was the first to restore Qi State. However, Tian Dan was quickly killed by Zhang Han, so Tian Rong took over the baton of the uprising.

At this time, there was a fire in the backyard of Qi State, so Tian Jia, the younger brother of King Tian Jian of Qi State, was elected as the King of Qi State by the Duke of Qi State.Faced with such a sudden change, Tian Rong quit his job and immediately started a fight, and successfully drove Tian Jia out of Qidi.Tian Jia was alone, so he immediately found the protective umbrella of King Huai of Chu.King Huai of Chu took him in in a humanitarian spirit.Tian Rong had no choice but to take the land leave, so he made Tian Dan's son Tian Shi king and continued the uprising.

At this time, Xiang Liang defeated Zhang Han and pursued him to Dingtao.Zhang Han chose to defend, but Xiang Liang wanted to clear Zhang Han as an obstacle to the rebel army as soon as possible, so he besieged the city while asking for help from the nearby Qi State.

Naturally, Tian Rong had the final say in the Qi State. Tian Rong said to Xiang Liang: "It's a piece of cake for me to send troops, but there is a condition, which is that Tian Jia Lai must be handed over."

Xiang Liang, an upright man, would not betray his allies. As a result, Tian Rong refused to send troops for this reason, which eventually led to Xiang Liang being attacked by Zhang Han and successfully bleeding on the battlefield.

If you, Tian Rong, weren't greedy for profit and refused to save him, how could my uncle have died?The family feud is irreconcilable!Xiang Yu hated Tian Rong deeply.

During the Battle of Julu, all the princes sent troops to rescue Zhao. Although they were all bluffing and acting according to the wind, they came out to support the scene. However, Tian Rong did not send a single soldier and did not even make a show.

After Zhang Han and other Qin generals surrendered, all the princes followed Xiang Yu into the pass, but Tian Rong was still confused and showed no sign.

It is precisely because of the intertwined hatred of family and country that Xiang Yu hated Tian Rong very much. During the "Xiting Enfeoffment", the juniors such as Tian Du, Tian An and Tian Shi were all enfeoffed, but Tian Rong was not included.

At that time, Tian Rong still had illusions and chose to wait for the good news at home.Soon, he received a "demolition order" written by Tiandu himself, ordering him to move out of Linzi from now on, and Linzi would be used by Tiandu from now on. Bargaining was refused, and the order would be implemented without any mistakes!

After reading this, Tian Rong was furious. Who are you Tiandu? Now you dare to ride on my head and dominate me. It's really lawless!Tian Rong immediately led his troops to attack Tiandu. How could Tiandu be Tian Rong's opponent?Soon, he fled to Chu State as a defeated general and went to his "eldest brother" Xiang Yu.

Tian Rong was very satisfied that he had saved Linzi, and recalled Tian Shi back to Qi.He said to Tian Shi: "Don't be afraid, as long as your uncle is here, no one can take away your territory."

But for Tian Shi, Tian Rong's words did not act as a reassurance, but instead acted as a catalyst.In Tian Shi's eyes, although Tian Rong is cruel, Xiang Yu is even more cruel; although Tian Rong is terrifying, Xiang Yu is even more terrifying.
